rows.note: Use 飯 as the all-purpose colloquial noun for an ordinary meal, especially when focusing on the food eaten.

example.english: We’ll go see a movie after the meal.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 sin1 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use 餐 when you mean the meal as a distinct eating occasion, serving, or scheduled meal.

example.english: This meal is on me; you don’t have to pay.
example.jyutping: nei1 caan1 ngo5 ceng2 nei5 m4 sai2 bei2 cin2

rows.note: Use 穀粉 only for grain ground into a flour-like food or feed ingredient, not for an eating occasion.

example.english: Grain flour can be used as an ingredient in a meal for babies.
example.traditional: 穀粉可用作嬰兒食品嘅原料。
example.jyutping: guk1 fan2 ho2 jung6 zok3 jing1 ji4 sik6 ban2 ge3 jyun4 liu6
